payload.claim: The test function is still named test_a_sub_cap_of_18_dollars_writes_none_and_37_writes_two, claiming the $37 share writes two follow-up specs. But this hunk changed `expected` for share=0.37 to `["SA-0108"]`, a single id, and the new docstring on the very next lines says so explicitly: "$37 covers one session but not a second, so only one is." The name is a leftover from when SPEC_WRITER_SESSION_USD was $18.50 (two sessions fit in $37); now that it is $23.00 the test's own name contradicts its own docstring and assertion, and no gate catches a test name disagreeing with its body.
